original_text: –Lens Compounding Practice–Ocular Lens = 10x mag–Objective Lens –20x mag–Total magnification power = –200x magnification–Ocular Lens = 10x mag–Objective Lens –10x mag–Total magnification power = –100x magnification–Ocular Lens = 10x mag–Objective Lens –40x mag–Total magnification power = –400x magnification
explanation:
This slide demonstrates how to calculate total magnification in a compound microscope by multiplying the magnification of the ocular lens (eyepiece) by the magnification of the objective lens.
- 10x ocular * 20x objective = 200x total magnification
- 10x ocular * 10x objective = 100x total magnification
- 10x ocular * 40x objective = 400x total magnification

questions.q: If a compound microscope has a 10x ocular lens and a 40x objective lens, what is the total magnification of the image?
questions.exp: Total magnification is ocular magnification multiplied by objective magnification (10x * 40x = 400x).
